migration.title: Import from legacy booth.db
migration.description: Validate and migrate data from the original ez-booth SQLite database into this browser.
migration.warning_title: This replaces browser data on this device
migration.warning_body: Before any migration is applied, the app automatically downloads a JSON backup of the current browser data.

status.ready_clean: Validation succeeded. The data is ready to import.
status.ready_issues: Validation finished with issues. Review them before importing.
status.importing: Replacing browser data with migrated records...

validation.skip_summary: If you continue with skipping, {vendors} vendor(s) and {purchases} purchase(s) will be dropped from the migration.
validation.action_guidance: Choose how to proceed with the migration:
validation.action_guidance_clean: • "Import validated records only" stays disabled when issues are found, because it only allows a fully clean import.
validation.action_guidance_skip: • "Skip invalid and import" imports the valid records and leaves the problematic records behind.

file_location.title: Find the original booth.db file

file_location.not_found_title: If the file is not there
file_location.not_found_body: Search your device for booth.db, or check where the original ez-booth app was installed. The browser cannot open that folder automatically, so you need to choose the file yourself.
file_location.use_file_picker: Please use the file picker above to browse for your booth.db file.

success.summary: Migration imported {booths} booth(s), {vendors} vendor(s), and {purchases} purchase(s). Skipped {skipped_vendors} vendor(s) and {skipped_purchases} purchase(s).

errors.state_unavailable: App state is not ready yet.

purchase_total_mismatch.title: Calculation Differences
purchase_total_mismatch.impact: {count} purchase(s) have totals that do not match their items
purchase_total_mismatch.explanation: Some purchases do not add up to the total saved in the legacy database.
purchase_total_mismatch.guidance: Review these carefully before importing. If you continue, the migrated data will keep the recalculated totals from the purchase items.

vendor_missing_booth.title: Vendors Belonging to Missing Events
vendor_missing_booth.impact: {count} vendor record(s) cannot be assigned to an event
vendor_missing_booth.explanation: Some vendor records point to an event that no longer exists in the legacy database.
vendor_missing_booth.guidance: If you continue, these vendors will be skipped because there is no event to attach them to.

purchase_missing_booth.title: Purchases Belonging to Missing Events
purchase_missing_booth.impact: {count} purchase record(s) cannot be assigned to an event
purchase_missing_booth.explanation: Some purchases point to an event that no longer exists in the legacy database.
purchase_missing_booth.guidance: If you continue, these purchases will be skipped because there is no event to attach them to.

purchase_item_missing_vendor.title: Purchase Items with Missing Vendors
purchase_item_missing_vendor.impact: {count} purchase item(s) refer to a vendor that is missing
purchase_item_missing_vendor.explanation: Some purchase items refer to vendor records that are no longer present in the legacy database.
purchase_item_missing_vendor.guidance: If you continue, the affected purchases will be skipped so incomplete sales are not imported.

purchase_without_items.title: Empty Purchases
purchase_without_items.impact: {count} purchase(s) do not contain any items
purchase_without_items.explanation: Some purchases were saved without any items in them.
purchase_without_items.guidance: If you continue, these empty purchases will be skipped because they cannot be imported safely.

issue.purchase_item_missing_vendor: Purchase {purchase_id} item {item_id} references missing vendor {vendor_id} in booth {booth_id}.
